title: Figma kit
description: Import curated Hewn tokens into Figma via Tokens Studio.
status: new
tier: free
---

The Figma kit is generated from the same curated packs as Theme Lab — six
identities, supported modes only, plus a sticker sheet for surfaces, button,
and input. No Figma plugin to maintain: Tokens Studio imports the JSON.

## Download

- [hewn.tokens.json](/figma/hewn.tokens.json) — Tokens Studio document
- [sticker-sheet.svg](/figma/sticker-sheet.svg) — visual reference sheet

## Import into Figma

1. Install [Tokens Studio](https://tokens.studio/) in your Figma file
2. Open Tokens → Import → select `hewn.tokens.json`
3. Switch themes (for example `forest / light`) and create Figma variables
4. Paste or place `sticker-sheet.svg` as a starting sticker sheet

Full component parity in Figma is future scope — this kit covers variables and
the core surface vocabulary.

## CLI

```bash
npx hewnui@latest theme export
```

Prints paths and import notes for the curated packs.
